newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: One killed, two wounded in Karachi bomb blast.
newsitem.headline: One killed, two wounded in Karachi bomb blast.

text.p: One person was killed and two were seriously wounded on Sunday when a bomb exploded in the eastern district of Pakistan's southern port city of Karachi, police said.
They said the bomb, which was planted on a motorcyle, went off in the eastern district of Landhi.

The breakaway Haqiqi faction of the ethnic Mohajir National Movement (MQM) blamed the main rival group for the explosion, which followed a shooting incident on Saturday in which a Haqiqi activist was killed and recovery of two bullet-riddled bodies in what appear to be a resumption of ethnic violence.
MQM denied the charge saying it had nothing to do with both the incidents.
More than 2,500 people, including 300 security officials, had been killed in political and ethnic violence in Karachi since 1995.
